svg.aria-label: Blood film. White cells with their normal share: neutrophil 40 to 75 percent (multilobed, raised in bacterial infection), lymphocyte 20 to 40 (round nucleus, raised in viral infection, TB, pertussis), monocyte 2 to 10 (largest, kidney-shaped nucleus), eosinophil 1 to 6 (two lobes, red granules, raised in allergy and parasites), basophil under 1 (dark granules). Red cell changes: normal discs, microcytic hypochromic cells and pencil cells in iron deficiency, target cells in thalassaemia trait, macro-ovalocytes with hypersegmented neutrophils in B12 or folate deficiency, spherocytes, sickle cells and bite cells.
